author: agent:claude-code
message: The 26.05 upgrade now covers the macbook too; record the build failure the eval-only check missed, its fix, and the nix-darwin option rename. (proposal 01a15d90-0405-76b6-8365-961b5be1117c, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

text: Every host moves to 26.05, the macbook included
why: Every host follows the 26.05 release: NixOS and NixOS-WSL hosts on nixos-26.05 (home-manager and NixOS-WSL release-26.05), the macbook on nixpkgs-26.05-darwin with nix-darwin-26.05 and home-manager release-26.05 (the user extended the upgrade to it, so the home modules need no 25.11 compatibility). stateVersion (the `version` in configurations) is not an upgrade knob: it stays at each host's install release (25.11), except vgkraken, a fresh minimal install made just before its first build, which starts at 26.05. .template-env's NIXCONFIG_VERSION (the release just and nix-darwin's first-time init use) is 26.05. Verified: check-hosts.sh evaluates every host (vgnixmini and the vgsquid servers PENDING on their hardware configs); every Linux host's home-files builds; vgwsl2 switched for real (exit 4 only from dbus -> dbus-broker, which needs a restart of the distro).

title: Evaluating every host passed, but the build of vgwsl2 failed: the upgrade was pushed broken
body: After the 26.05 bump check-hosts.sh passed for every host and commit 75540ba was pushed, but `nixos-rebuild switch` on vgwsl2 failed building home-manager-files ('Error installing file .config/nvim/init.lua outside $HOME'). File clashes and paths outside $HOME are caught only when home-files is built, never by evaluating drvPaths. Lesson: before pushing an input bump, also build each Linux host's `homeConfigurations.<host>.config.home-files` (small, no desktop closure) or switch one host for real.

title: home-manager 26.05 writes nvim/init.lua, which can't land inside the out-of-store nvim.d link
body: programs.neovim now generates init.lua (provider settings) as xdg.configFile."nvim/init.lua"; with xdg.configFile."nvim" an mkOutOfStoreSymlink to nvim.d, home-manager refuses to install it ('outside $HOME') and the generation fails to build. Fixed with programs.neovim.sideloadInitLua = true: the generated lua loads through the wrapper (--cmd dofile) and nvim.d/init.lua stays the user's. Lesson: a live-edited config directory linked out of store must keep home-manager from writing files inside it.

title: nix-darwin 26.05: homebrew.brewPrefix became homebrew.prefix
body: The old option pointed at the bin directory (/opt/homebrew/bin); homebrew.prefix is Homebrew's root (/opt/homebrew, as brew --prefix prints). The homebrew module builds brew's path and the launchd agents' PATH from `${homebrew.prefix}/bin`.
